name: Four Seasons Hotel Minneapolis
positioning: Downtown Minneapolis hotel on Hennepin Avenue, connected by Skyway and two blocks from the Mississippi River
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base near the stadiums and the river
Guests who want a spa, pools and Chef Gavin Kaysen's restaurant under one roof

facts.text: The hotel is at 245 Hennepin Avenue, Minneapolis.
The hotel is two blocks from the Mississippi River.
The hotel is connected by Skyway to premier sports venues, corporate hubs and world-class entertainment.
Mara Restaurant & Bar is Gavin Kaysen's restaurant at the hotel.
Riva Terrace is a rooftop restaurant and bar serving Italian cuisine.
Socca Café serves specialty coffees, flaky pastries, grain bowls and Sicilian pizza squares.
The Spa has six treatment rooms, including a VIP suite.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor pools.

highlights.text: The Premier River-View Room has views of the Mississippi and the Hennepin Bridge.
The Premier River-View Room has an oval tub in the oversized bathroom.
The One-Bedroom Stadium Suite has panoramic views of the city skyline including three professional sports stadiums.
The hotel has a fourth-floor pool plaza.
The 24-hour Fitness Centre has functional fitness equipment by TRX, LifeFitness, Peloton and Tonal.

considerations.text: Overnight valet parking is USD 68 plus taxes.
The outdoor pool hours are seasonal.
The Fitness Centre is for hotel guests only.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
